_comment: Behavior-state model for the Live2D director (Phase 2a). Pure state axes: valence [-1,1], arousal [0,1], engagement [0,1]. Mood tags are pulses that apply fully on a mood CHANGE and with diminishing returns on repeats (idle = 0), then decay exponentially toward baseline using half-lives. Loaded by src/behavior_state.py; the module ships matching defaults so it works standalone for tests.
_decay_note: Half-lives in seconds: the time for an axis to move half-way toward its target (exponential toward baseline). valence -> closeness baseline (~0), arousal -> 0.5, engagement -> condition-dependent target. Larger = slower. I will tune these.
